title: Delete the superseded Story 19.5 AuthState test now that Story 20.5 fully re-covers it

evidence.quote: group('Story 19.5 — superseded by Epic 20 v2 unified AuthState', () {

why: The group's own name says the story is superseded, yet the test (asserting AuthState.signedOut/signedIn shape with tier: cloudBorn) was left in place instead of being removed when epic_20_hard_tier_auth_test.dart's Story 20.5 group added equivalent (localBorn-variant) coverage of the same AuthState contract. Both files must now be kept in sync by hand whenever AuthState's shape changes.
recommendation: Delete the Story 19.5 group from epic_19_offline_first_test.dart; Story 20.5 in epic_20_hard_tier_auth_test.dart is the current owner of this contract.
acceptance_criteria: epic_19_offline_first_test.dart no longer contains a 'Story 19.5' group
The epic_20 story-acceptance run still passes, confirming Story 20.5 covers the same assertions

corrections: 20.5's group (epic_20_hard_tier_auth_test.dart:143) only asserts the localBorn variant, not cloudBorn as 19.5 does — not literally 'equivalent' coverage between just these two groups. The actual redundant/superseding coverage is test/features/auth/domain/models/auth_state_test.dart:133-304, which tests both tiers and wasn't cited.
